title: Google’s AI Just Built the App for You
script: What if you didn’t search for an app? What if AI just built it. Google’s new Labs experiment, Tabletop, gives groups one shared space and one AI agent. You type what you need. It makes the tool. Need a trip itinerary? Built. Dinner poll? Built. Expense splitter? Tournament bracket? Built right there. Everyone can edit together, like a Google Doc. It’s still a limited US waitlist test. But the shift is bigger than one demo. AI isn’t just answering questions anymore. It’s making the software in the moment you need it.
cta: Follow AI Tested for AI tools that actually change workflows.
concept: Product demo storyboard: prompt turns into tools, rapid tool cards, collaborative workspace, finish on shift from answers to apps.
